**JI’AN CITY, JIANGXI PROVINCE, CHINA – SEPTEMBER 3, 2024** Drunk speeding driver fails to control his vehicle, drives out of his lane on a curve and hits two slow-moving people on a scooter or bike.
Both are thrown several metres into the air by the force of the impact and both die instantly.
One of the victims is a young woman; the identity of the other victim has never been released.
The accident was recorded by a security camera and its aftermath by several witnesses.
